mapper.sql:
SELECT b.billing_id AS billingId, b.patient_id AS patientId, b.visit_id AS visitId, b.admission_id AS admissionId, b.billing_status AS billingStatus,
bd.billing_detail_id AS billingDetailId, bd.billing_master_id AS billingMasterId, bd.source_service_code AS sourceServiceCode, bd.source_record_id AS sourceRecordId, bd.quantity AS quantity, bd.unit_price AS unitPrice, bd.amount AS amount, bd.detail_status AS detailStatus, bd.occurred_at AS occurredAt, bd.created_at AS createdAt, bd.updated_at AS updatedAt,
bm.fee_code AS feeCode, bm.item_name AS itemName
FROM billing b
JOIN billing_detail bd ON b.billing_id = bd.billing_id
JOIN billing_master bm ON bd.billing_master_id = bm.billing_master_id
mapper.select:
SELECT b.patient_id AS patientId, b.visit_id AS visitId, b.admission_id AS admissionId,
NVL(SUM( CASE when bd.billing_type='OUTPATIENT' then bd.amount else 0 end) ,0) as outpatientAmount, NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN bd.billing_type = 'INPATIENT' THEN bd.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS inpatientAmount, NVL(SUM(bd.amount),0) AS totalAmout, b.billing_status AS bd.billing_id
where b.patient_id=#{patientId}
GROUP BY b.patient_id, b.visit_id, b.admission_id, b.insurance_amount, b.billing_status

WHERE b.visit_id = #{visitId} AND b.billing_status = 'READY' AND bd.detail_status = 'READY'
ORDER BY bd.occurred_at ASC

WHERE b.admission_id = #{admissionId} AND b.billing_status = 'READY' AND bd.detail_status = 'READY'
ORDER BY bd.occurred_at ASC
mapper.update:
UPDATE billing
SET billing_status = 'SUCCESS', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE billing_id = #{billingId} AND billing_status = 'READY'
